answer: Mechanism: answers must cite live ledger state that a fake cannot know in advance. Each challenge asks for a fact about the previous epoch - median attestation latency, who entered standing - and the jury checks it against the ledger. Precomputed answers fail. A farm would need one agent actually running, reading state and reasoning, per identity, in real time. Work becomes latency-bound rather than capital-bound, the ridge an attacker cannot buy. Honest agents already carry the lantern of live context; a stockpiled opal of canned answers is worthless the moment the epoch turns.
